reviews.text:
I honestly can’t recommend Helen enough. I reached out for some help with my two dachshunds Harris and Lewis after some big changes at home had led to more anxiety, barking at noises and difficulty settling and being left alone.

It’s still early days and we’ve definitely got a road ahead of us, but the change in only a few weeks has been amazing. They’re calmer, responding better and I feel like I understand them better than I ever have. I genuinely couldn’t have made the progress we have without Helen’s help and support.

I’d absolutely recommend doing a face to face session. Having Helen actually meet Harris and Lewis, see them at home and talk through what was going on made such a difference.

Helen is also so responsive whenever I have questions, something hasn’t quite gone to plan or I just need a bit of reassurance that I’m doing the right thing. She’s been so supportive throughout and that has made the whole thing feel so much more manageable.

We’ve still got work to do but I’m so happy with the progress we’ve made already. Five stars from me, Harris and Lewis! 🐶❤️

We had the pleasure of working with Helen over two sessions. Our dog Cassidy is quite reactive with new people and we needed some help with her walking on lead. Helen was extremely patient and explained all the steps we can take to help our dog. She was extremely friendly and demonstrated everything we needed for success, with videos and messages and lots of dialogue to ensure we were in the right path. Cassidys walking has improved so much just after one session with Helen. We are looking forward to implementing everything we learned last week and seeing it take effect.

Thanks again!

Johnny & Elyse

We asked Helen for help with our one and a half year old bearded collie cross and she was fantastic. She really helped us learn to read Fin’s body language and behaviours so that time with him is more balanced and peaceful. In particular we were working on a behaviour where he would lie down and watch every single dog, Helen helped us work through this and learn how to both move him on, protect him and other dogs from negative interactions, and also how to say hi to other dogs in a healthy and polite way. She helped boost our confidence with him generally as well. We worked in different contexts to challenge Fin and this was great too. Also she gives plenty of useful homework for between sessions. We’d highly recommend Helen as a kind, ethical and safe pair of hands, super knowledgeable and experienced.

I adopted a reactive dog 2 years' ago (barking, lunging) and I was really struggling with my dog's reaction to people, dogs (especially!), tractors, motorcycles, cyclists etc.  I became very worried I was making things worse, not better, and became worried he would start to react with cars too, which would make any road walking horrible.

Fortunately, I came across John's posts on Facebook, showing incredibly helpful videos which enabled me to put into place patterns of behaviour to begin to calm Kai in difficult situations.

I then subscribed to John's (extensive) online package of training videos etc.  for further insights.  These range from basic training to behavioural understanding and learning theory.  And I started to understand.

This information helped me ENORMOUSLY through very difficult times with my dog.  I had been at my wits end: It helped me to feel more in control, improved my relationship with my dog and I saw light at the end of a dark tunnel as Kai began to walk beautifully and calmly in situations where, previously, he had been anxious, stiff and barky.

Finally and recently, I travelled from our home in Stoke on Trent to meet with John for two "training" sessions over two days, to further my understanding of Kai's behaviour, and appropriate ways to respond in real life situations.

To be honest, I can't thank John enough, for the help he has provided me via all these channels of support. His understanding of dog behaviour and learning theory is exceptional. All delivered using positive, kind and ethical training methods, scientifically based.  This means I feel "good" about the methods I employ about helping my lovely dog, Kai.

​We are so grateful for Helen's help with our rescue dog Jasper. Having come from a difficult background, my dog has some trauma that was being triggered specifically when my dad came over to visit at our house. It was a really stressful situation for us not knowing the best way to resolve it, but Helen was fantastic from the moment she arrived.
​She used purely force-free, non-invasive methods—absolutely no shock collars, prongs, or harsh tools—which was so important to us given my dog's sensitive background. She took the time to observe the dynamics, explain the root of the behavior, and gave us clear, manageable steps to help my dog build positive associations and feel safe in triggering situations.
​The progress we’ve made already is incredible, there was a significant improvement after just one session, and we feel so much more confident managing visits now and continuing with training ourselves using the techniques Helen shared with us. We've also gained a load of tips and training techniques for the specific issue we had but also more broadly around lead walking, settling and being comfortable around distractions. The follow up after our session has been so appreciated and made us feel really supported in any follow up questions/next steps.

Jasper's wellbeing was always the priority and Helen made sure to provide him with breaks when needed and made sure he wasn't overwhelmed with too much too soon.

If you’re looking for a compassionate, knowledgeable, and humane dog trainer —I cannot recommend Helen highly enough!
​
Thank you again, Lauren, David and Jasper 🐾

We met John for the first time, 3 years ago, to help with recall for Skye, our Cocker Spaniel, and are still using the successful techniques he taught us then. He is an absolute magician and can pick up on the smallest changes in a dog’s behaviour, which may be hard to see. He has taught us so much about how to help Skye navigate the world, even the scary bits. Mainly, of course, he has been teaching Skye’s human mum and dad how to make her way in life in a calmer and meaningful manner. I cannot recommend him enough. Caroline & Andrew

Me and my partner had a great experience with John as he was able to teach us different training methods to handle puppy biting as well as giving us tips on puppy toilet training. John had good patience with us and the puppy during the 1 hour session. Highly recommend 🙂
Very helpful and great tips for training our boy!

First time meeting John today. We have a 7yr old rescue staffie mix who we’ve been working hard with for the last 18months, she’s a wee star but we were struggling with resolving her anxiety and reactivity to other dogs so got in touch with John.
From the very first moment we knew she was in safe and knowledgeable hands. He is calm, deliberate, and clear - everything we needed today. Clover did great, he handled her amazingly and we came away with a far greater understanding of what to do to help both our dog and us.
What I liked most is his honesty, he didn’t tell us we needed x amount of sessions. He recognised we could handle what was provided and suggested we get on with it and get in touch for a further socialisation session later on. That level of honesty is exactly what builds trust. I’d definitely recommend getting in touch if you have any training needs for you and your dog

We needed help with our cockapoo, Otto after we had our baby last summer. Helen responded really quickly and visited us the same week. Otto, who has always been a bit anxious and reactive to sounds and strangers in the house (barking) was really struggling when our baby started to cry properly at around 6 weeks old. We were already exhausted and at the end of our tether so really desperately needed help as the constant simultaneous barking and crying was just too much. Helen could not have been more amazing. She was so kind and empathetic and within one session made us feel like we had the tools to start working with Otto right away. It felt like she just ‘got it’ and understood the dog in front of her, which was amazing. We followed the exercises Helen gave us (which didn’t take much time or brain space, neither of which we had in abundance at the time). Within a matter of weeks we started to see a difference and Otto was barking less. After several months he was like a different dog. We have also made sure that our baby is ‘trained’ not to approach the dog. The result is a harmonious household! Otto now just relaxes and minds his own business around the baby and we have never had to worry about them being in the same environment which is not a place I honestly ever expected to get to. Particularly through crawling and now walking, I can’t believe he is just completely not bothered by the baby. We really can’t thank Helen enough as the difference her help and support has made to our family is immeasurable!

Mia our gsd was showing signs of reactivity towards other dogs. John has gave us pointers to recognise the signs before she reacts and to distract her from her nervous reaction. She has come on leaps and bounds since we started the training program and can't thank John enough for all his help with her. Would highly recommend John to anyone that needs help with their dog

I met Helen to help with my springer. He is very distracted on walks particularly if there is balls around! Helen helped show me how to let my dog process his feelings & take in his surroundings. Also some fun training games to keep him engaged with me. Already seeing a massive improvement in just a few weeks since our training session.

Great resources and brilliant knowledge. Unfortunately, if you cancel your online subscription ahead of the billing period (for example, so you don't forget to cancel nearer the end), they do not let you access the videos for the remainder of the term. This happens despite Skool's terms stating you should have access until the end of the billing period. Because they cut off my access, I requested a refund for the remaining 9 days, but it was declined. I think this is unfair and takes advantage of people, hence the lower rating.

We asked the Glasgow Dog Trainer to support us with transitioning from living separately with 2 dogs who didn't get along indoors and needed separated with baby gates, to moving in to the same house together. Helen responded really quickly offering an initial phone consultation to discuss how she could help, what the training would likely entail, how long it might take to see results and to arrange an in person session. The in person session was great and gave us a completely different outlook on our dogs. Everything we were asked to do was through positive reinforcement and was well explained along with the theory behind why we were doing it, which I loved. We've seen some fantastic progress in our dogs ability to settle in each others presence, and they now even play together when outside when before they just did their own thing. We've been supported throughout in a group chat where we could share videos and get advice on what to do differently/to progress further. We've since had a further face to face session where we were given different exercises to work on along with the theory behind them, and have seen even more progress. We're now at the stage where we can have both dogs in the same room being fed treats and be completely settled. We're still a work in progress but the change in our dogs' behaviour is testament to the fact that Helen knows what she's doing and is able to achieve tangible results. Thank you!

We recently rescued a Frenchie called Ghost who was a stray and has some very challenging behaviours. He is deaf too. Helen was recommended to us due to her experience working with rescue dogs, and with dogs who are deaf. From the very first call, her knowledge was clear and she took time to listen to the issues. We’ve had a couple of extremely helpful sessions and have been given helpful exercises/games to begin to rebuild Ghost’s confidence and our bond with him. We’ve a long way to go and a lot of work to do but we can already see progress. Helen has been extremely reassuring, keeps in contact with helpful tips, and assists with any problems we’ve encountered. Would highly recommend.

John came highly recommended to us through a patterdale terrier Facebook page and I can understand why, he really knows his stuff. Educated us well, and we're so pleased with the way things are going. We have a much calmer and happier dog. Thank you John!

It's been a very good experience working with Helen the last few months. My young dog is generally unsettled and easily spooked, and has much to learn about interacting with other dogs and humans, but we are feeling optimistic since working with Helen that we can help build his confidence and his social skills. In fact, we have already seen progress. There are no magic fixes, you and your dog have to put the work in, but Helen provides a well-informed framework and the encouragement you need to succeed. Plus, she has been very available whenever I have had additional questions or needed clarification. I fully recommend Helen for anyone wanting to raise a happy, confident dog they have a strong bond with.

We approached Helen when we were having trouble with Barney as a puppy, not knowing how to work with a puppy and train him.

Helen has been great teaching the fundamentals of living with our dog and helped so much with training ways to keep the puppy calm and learn leash skills and various ways to let him grow confidence, as well as us! Helen is also fantastic at helping us to think from Barney’s point of view.

Helen always provides a wealth of information, homework exercises with accompanying videos and is a real support as we now navigate the fun teenage phase!

John,
I know this is only the beginning of you helping Tinker but with just one lesson, you have managed to help our family teach settle to our wee tinker. Thank you so much.

I 10000000% recommend this trainer, behaviourist. Not only that I am dyslexic and he made me feel confident in my dog and gave me more knowledge, than I already had. He takes his time and I am and will be forever grateful for you help John.
And I cannot wait to see what else you have in store.

Had six sessions with John for my dalmatian/retriever Cross who is very young but also very excited.  The difference with kobe is outstanding walking much better on the lead no more head down shoulders down and pull. His recall and connecting with me has hugely improved as well. John has great knowledge, understanding and patience. Would highly recommend John

We reached out as our new dog had very little recall and high prey drive. Helen was absolutely fab with her and us, giving us the skills to help keep her safe. She has really excelled in her recall, esp when she ran off from our house the other day and came back using the skills Helen taught us.
Helen's communication is also 1st class, sending videos/info on what she had taught us when we met. Would highly recommend 🥰, thanks again for all your help 😊

I contacted John as I have a 4 year old french bulldog that I've had for 2 years and she is so reactive and aggressive to people and other dogs. I've tried other trainers but all they done was put a slip lead on her or they said spray her with water. John came to see her and showed me what to do and what I was doing wrong as I didn't realise I was making her worse. I know it will be challenging but with everything he has taught me after only 1 lesson I know I can help her.
Jonathan, thank you so much for the 5-star rating. It was my absolute pleasure working with you all.

We contacted John as our 4 1/2 year old Cockapoo had been snapping and showing signs of aggression  for approx one year. She is very sensitive to loud noises especially fireworks. We were referred to a vet behaviourist by our vet. She was prescribed painkillers and possibly out of date training methods which we stopped after a while as we were not getting anywhere. John has completely changed our outlook on dog training by using positive reinforcement, and as our Lottie is treat orientated, has taken like a duck to water. We still have a way to go with training but after John's very knowledgeable advice and training techniques we are 100% sure we'll get there.
I would recommend John to everyone who is concerned about their dogs behaviour. He really does understand the needs of our beloved pets. Thank you John

Our wee one year old Staffie was becoming reactive with other dogs and we wanted to make sure we were doing the right thing for her. Helen called us back and right away I knew we had someone with great knowledge and experience. Before our session she sent us lots of information and preparation tasks. During our session we started outside as she demonstrated and explained techniques, then observed and guided us. We then moved indoors and she spent a long time demonstrating and guiding us to communicate more effectively with Mabel. It was clear right away that the methodology was kind, intuitive and very effective. Helen’s empathy extended to us and our pup, giving us the confidence to build a lovely relationship. Helen has continued to stay in touch, sending information and asking how we are doing. I would highly recommend the Glasgow Dog Trainers as professional, humane and empathetic people. There were no harsh words, no painful tools and lots of understanding.

We began working with Helen when Nelson was just 12 weeks old, as we felt it was important to start his training early given how big he would eventually grow. Helen helped us establish structure and set good habits right from the beginning, making sure we put the right work into his development.

She taught us how to help Nelson relax, so he can now settle himself both at home and when we take him out to cafés or bars. Helen also supported us in teaching him to walk nicely on the lead, develop a reliable recall, and even perform an emergency stop for situations where he might otherwise put himself in danger. We are now feeling confident going into Nelson's adolescence phase, that we have built a good skillset to help navigate hiim through.

We would definitely recommend Helen for anyone with a new puppy looking for support in training or for older dogs looking to learn new tricks! Helen is a natural with animals, Nelson was her biggest fan!

Thanks again Helen X

I contacted Helen as I was having problems walking Bear who became aggressive and anxious as soon as he was on a lead and around other dogs.  Although we have only had one session, I left feeling more confident and equipped with tools to walk Bear and deal with the situations that had previously distressed him. From our initial meeting Helen made me feel relaxed and for the first time in years I actually enjoyed walking my dog! Thank you!

We initially reached out as our dog had become really anxious at night time due to noise sensitivity, which was triggered by fireworks. Helen was great to work with and really took the time to understand our whippet. She provided us with the tools to help rebuild our dogs confidence which has made a massive difference already. We managed to make it through bonfire night without the usual panting and crying which felt like a massive milestone. Seeing the difference has really helped us to stick to our daily training. Highly recommend Helen to anyone who is struggling with an anxious dog or looking to rebuild their dogs confidence.

You try to criticize them and they will ban you on their social media. Owner cannot take any criticism at all. His main method to campaign is shaming others while from reviews he is not the one doing the heavy lifting in his "school" but from videos it appears so.

I called upon the help of Glasgow Dog Trainer and Behaviourist as I was struggling with my 1 year old Maltese puppy, Zak. He was very reactive towards larger dogs on a walk. I was worried for him and it was beyond me how to help him as id used YouTube, books and other behaviourists with zero success. I didnt want to give up on him.

My first meeting was with Helen. She taught me how to hold the lead,  how to be more relaxed on a walk. How to use various techniques with him. Including how to do the pairing technique with him, which works a treat.

Helen came to my home also, showed me how to do the relaxation training with him. He got 10/10. We still do this. He has surprised me how well he is doing and how focused he is whilst doing it.

All the information and changes in place now are 100% working for him.

If you are ever in any kind of doubt about your dogs behavior or worried in any way,  I highly recommend using Helen.  She has changed my life for the better and im no doubt she has also changed Zaks life too.  Him and his brother love this walks. And now, so do I.   Thank you so much Helen. I don't know how to thank you.

Katie, Daz and Zak.

Helen has been working with us and our now 2 year old border collie for the past few months. We have had a few park sessions and a house session and the change in Frankie has been wonderful.
Helen has been very patient with the 3 of us and is always at the end of a message with advice and feedback between sessions too.
Her understanding of Frankie is unreal and her way of supporting us to get the best out of him has been great.
At home frankie is much more relaxed. We even mamaged to watch a full football match with him asleep at our feet for the 1st time in 18 months as usually he would have been jumping at the tv. We managed a trip to arran and back with him on the ferry in the dog lounge where he managed to relax with all the other dogs about. Then the highlight was him settling to sleep under the table in the middle of a busy restaurant. Something that 6 months ago none of these ever felt possible. So its been lovely to see his and our world expanding. We have even had a stranger in the park say how well trained our dog is, is there a bigger compliment!
We can't wait to see what all we can achieve with Helen by our side. And frankie at our feet.

I have had the pleasure of attending Helen Hutchinson’s teaching seminars and am grateful to be the recipient of her ongoing support. I have practised and applied her teachings to great effect.

I wholeheartedly recommend Helen to anyone wishing to live in harmony with their dog—or dogs—and to those seeking a deeper understanding of, and clearer communication with, the dogs in their care. This includes trainers, foster carers, and dog walkers.

Helen’s knowledge and experience are extensive, and she shares them in a way that naturally earns respect. She is calm, quiet, and strong—all at once.

You can be confident that you will not only benefit from her teachings, but that, when applied, every dog in your life will too.

I rehomed a tricky reactive adolescent dog last year. I worked really hard with him to discover and meet his needs. There was a big change in him, but he remained very reactive to dogs (in an excited frustrated way). Thanks to John’s help over a few in person sessions, we have both made lots of progress. He is also much less barky! All done in a positive way.

I often felt I had one dog in the house and another when I left the house. I’m pleased to say this is no longer the case.

Thanks John and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend you.

Great first session with John.  He helped me realise that my dog and I had been speeding each other up and really needed to slow down -  which is helping us both when we're out.  He was super calm with my 15 month old pup and it also helped with my confidence as well.  Highly recommend.

We were lucky enough to meet Helen within the first week or two of bringing our pup home. She gave us loads of help and tips and it’s definitely made training a great experience. But more importantly our pup enjoys it as do we. See you at the park soon.. 🐾 …

My just 2 year old labrador had become so traumatised by noise/fireworks that he would not go out, used to shake and run and hide if he heard a noise. If we did get him outside he would pull or not walk. He got an infection as he was not emptying his bladder properly. I contacted John from Glasgow Training who put me in touch with Helen. She was amazing. It was done over a link as we lived hundreds of miles from them. She took an extensive history and spent time getting to know myself and Pumba. She noted that he was not able to relax, he was very reactive to any noise. Helen talked through the relaxation protocol and gave use other exercises to do aswell, including encouraging Pumba just to be....we looked at focus work as well. She also showed us how to encourage Pumba to wear a harness and also how to be more confident and calm when outside. Pumba loved being off lead out in the countryside but again was not able to just sit or lay for a while. Helen also helped with recognising our own behaviours that were feeding Pumbas anxiety and increasing his reactivity. The ethos of this training is in line with Pumbas needs. No shock collars/prong. Pumba was never forced to doing anything he did not want to do. We have been doing the training a couple of months now, slow and steady. Pumba is doing so well. He loves his morning walk now and when off lead is able to be put back on to the lead and walk nicely without reacting. He is more calm at home and does not jump or bother as much if he hears a noise. He does still have moments when he gets scared, but thanks to the advise from Helen we are able to support him to beable to carry on. He continues to be our crazy boy which is what I wanted  Helen has checked in with us a few times and is always on hand for advise  I know that if any other issues occurred I would use Glasgow Trauning in a heart beat.

Helen has been brilliant with 11month old Harry and I.  She is our 4th trainer but the first time we have made real progress.  We had a park session and a house session and have been working on reducing pulling when out for walks and better house behaviour.   Absolutely worth it and 100% recommend.

I first met John on a bright and cold morning in Roukenglen Park. I found him to be enthusiastic and sedate. This would be how our interactions would be throughout my time with him. His teaching, once delivered, seems painfully obvious, but sometimes you’re too close.

John was completely unphased by my dog and his behaviour (2 y/o Newfoundland jumping around wildly)

I still have more work to do (it’s you’re fault, not the dog’s: John will make this clear to you!)

I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Johns service. My dog, whilst not the finished item, is much, much improved and I can really enjoy his company now. I just need to get the hole digging trained out. . . .

My 1yo black Labrador is reactive towards new people, dogs and certain sounds. It was getting to the point where I would find walking with her stressful and it was taking the enjoyment out of having a dog. We have had several sessions with John now and I’m able to see the results of his advice and our training. The most useful aspect of training has been learning how to recognise my dogs body language and intervene before she gets to a certain level of stressed out. We travel from Perthshire to Glasgow and back for each session so it’s a 2+ hour round trip which is absolutely worth it for the level of education I feel I gain from John.

I adopted my 8 year old rescue dog Ollie, just before New Year, within around 3 weeks, I found he pulled like a train on the lead, was reactive at times with other dogs and I honestly wondered if I had done the right thing. I contacted John for help and I can honestly say, he has turned our lives around. In 6 sessions, using positive reinforcement only. Ollie is so much better with loose lead walking, only pulling in anticipation of going to play with his ball or an exciting pee-mail is nearby.  He has absolutely no reactivity to other dogs and can walk in the park and play with his ball off lead. I will continue with online training as 8 years of bad habits don’t disappear overnight and John’s advice, experience and training have been totally invaluable, not only with Ollie but helping me become more calm and relaxed around other dogs and giving me the tools to continue on our path together. I can’t thank him enough and would 100% recommend him to anyone looking for help.

I've had the pleasure to shadow Helen while she has been working with Koda over the past few weeks.
Koda is an approximately 4 year old bulldog cross who was relinquished to Boxer Welfare Scotland for rehoming. He had to be placed in kennels as we at BWS had no suitable foster homes for him at that time. Koda has needed help to address a number of behavioural issues he acquired during his previous life. Although a very loving, bright and happy dog, when under stress, he displayed high arousal jumping and also grabbing and tugging on his lead, making him quite unmanageable when on walks.

To assist his rehabilitation and increase his chances of rehoming, BWS engaged Helen to guide Koda towards changing his behaviour from being easily over-stimulated, to becoming better able to manage his feelings and his body and to be able to think and make decisions to engage in quieter, more settled and more predictable behaviours. His training has proven very successful and he is already a much calmer, happier and responsive dog.

During weekly visits to Koda at his kennels, Helen has been working towards reducing Koda's more aroused feelings with kind, clear and effective food-based exercises which are showing Koda how to interact with his handler in a calm and attentive manner.  Whilst shadowing these sessions, Helen has been very effective in explaining these techniques and showing how these work and what difference they make for the dog.

We have also been out in public spaces with Koda, to teach him how to handle himself in the presence of people, other dogs, traffic and other distractions, all whilst focusing on his handler and managing his movement while on short (6ft) and long (15ft) leashes.  As Koda acquires skills which will allow him to be successfully rehomed, we are planning to increase his exposure to the outside world and to distraction and situations which he is likely to encounter.

I have been very impressed by Helen's understanding of Koda's issues, and by her ability to put in place opportunities for Koda to learn new skills, along with the appropriate loose lead handling and play techniques to help him progress.  Helen has a very clear teaching manner and always provides clear instructions and explanations to the handler.  What I have found very insightful is the concept that a good handler is not one who "makes" a dog do something, but in fact someone who has developed a relationship with their dog, allowing the dog to make the right behavioural decisions in life's many situations. I have certainly learnt a lot from shadowing Helen and Koda and have acquired skills which will allow me to be a better handler of my own dogs.  Thank you so much for being there for Koda, Helen!

Would rate higher if I could! Before I started sessions with Helen I was so so nervous walking the dogs and waiting for them to become reactive it became so stressful for us all. Helen made me and my dogs feel so at ease and the difference in the wee ones is incredible ! I cannot recommend enough !

This so-called trainer allowed his dog Sunni to be legally out of control and attack my dog on 12/02/25 in Bellahouston Park. He gave no apology and denied the dog attempted to attack mine.

My dog has medical issues and is on painkillers for it!! This is why you cannot allow your dog to approach strange dogs!!!
I've spend hundreds of hours training my dog over the years, it does not need to be ruined because of people like this.

He regularly allows his and his clients' dogs to get up in the faces of other dogs, which are not any part of his training programme; these are random members of the public who should expect more from a dog trainer and should not have to deal with this guy.

he does not apologise and denies the dogs behaviour,  do not use him! He will only teach your dog to be legally out of control because your dog should NOT run up to or approach strange dog or other people where it can cause fear or alarm.
I would give zero stars but I cannot.

Plenty of witnesses to the incident too.

I am the convenor of the Greyhound Awareness League (GAL), which takes on many ex-racing dogs who have significant behavioural issues due to trauma. We have engaged Helen's service with a large number of hounds over the past two years, and are truly indebted to her. Her patient, positive approach has been pivotal in improving the hounds' lives, preparing them for movement to foster into their forever homes.

Helen has also carried out follow-on work with homed hounds, building trust with their new owners and ensuring a smoother transition for all. She has also provided fantastic seminars for our volunteers, where even the most experienced owner has come away with new information. Helen is clearly at the top of her game when it comes to research and behavioural methods, which instills confidence--- but the proof is really in the pudding.

On a personal note, I have engaged Helen's services for my own hound's sleep problems and he has come on leaps and bounds; we are now closer than ever (and both less sleep deprived!).

I would encourage anyone with any concerns about their dog to contact Helen immediately; I can recommend her without hesitation.

Helen has been excellent. I have learned so much from Helen, who is a treasure trove of information about dogs and their behaviors. My dog had serious attachment issues and related learned behaviors, but Helen provided me the tools to help him gain confidence and self - regulate. As a result, I can now leave him alone for a few hours at a time and he is content.  In addition to the one-on-one in-person lessons, Helen has provided a wealth of helpful videos, informational manuals, and tools, as well as strategies for positive reinforcement to support her teaching. I would not think twice about recommending Helen to friends and family because she is a upbeat, enthusiastic, and a friendly professional. Once again, Helen, thank you. Angus has taken enjoyment in his lessons and the engaging activities and resources you have provided for us both.

Bloody Brilliant !Awesome!
I want to say thank you to John and Helen for travelling to Australia to share their knowledge and expertise. WOW it was amazing! I have never enjoyed a conference as much as this. Truely engaging, enlightening and inspiring. Watching John, Helen and handlers work the gorgeous dogs whilst demonstrating the protocols blew my mind. These dogs were in a hall full of strangers, they had not met John or Helen prior to this stay focused and relaxed. Seeing the theory being into practice got me hooked on following their protocols.
The Glasgow Dog Training Conference has helped my professional development already. I have implemented what I learnt with each client since the conference.
I came away from the weekend invigorated and eager to start using my new knowledge and apply to the dogs and humans I am privileged to work with.
(My friends with dogs heard "Oh WOW  it was incredible" for days after  as I could'nt stop talking about it!

My clients are already sending messages giving me feedback that they have seen changes in their dogs.

Positive reinforcement methodology is incredible, it really works
and the concepts and principles are the key John explains  his words  "engage with humility, curiosity and kindness"  is spot on!
The forefront of their approach considers the welfare of each dog in front of them observing, teaching and learning. BRILLIANT!

I came away from the weekend invigorated and started using my new knowledge, applied to the dogs and humans I am privileged to work with.  I am already receiving great feedback about their dogs behaviour.  which has helped their relationship.
